account.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete your account? This action cannot be undone.

preview.title: Test as new user
preview.description: Creates a temporary sandbox profile. All data (log, weight, calibration) is automatically deleted when you exit. Your real account is not affected.
preview.activeInfo: You are now navigating as a new user. The banner at the top confirms the mode.
preview.exit: Exit preview and delete test data
preview.withFreeView: Free view is active too — you will see the app as a new free user, which is what most new users actually are.

dataExport.title: Export my data
dataExport.description: Download all your personal information in machine-readable format (JSON or CSV). You have this right under GDPR.
dataExport.info: The file contains everything we store about you: profile, food diary, recipes, saved meals, weight and measurement data, messages, shares, support conversations and consent log.
dataExport.success: Your data has been exported as {{format}}
dataExport.partialWarning: The export finished, but some parts could not be retrieved. Contact support if something is missing.

errors.notLoggedIn: You must be logged in to export data
errors.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Log in again and retry.
errors.timeout: The export took too long. Please try again shortly.
errors.network: Network error — check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: Could not export data. Please try again later.
